title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.40418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. translated_title: IMPACT：基于逆变器信息的多模态学习用于光伏发电预测
translated_abstract: 本工作开发了一个物理信息驱动的多模态深度学习框架，用于10至110分钟提前期的概率性光伏功率预测。该预测模型建立在四分支架构之上，分别编码电站级时间历史（通过与学习邻接矩阵相结合的图注意力编码器）、逆变器级空间云动态、已知未来的太阳几何信息以及当前气象状态，并通过门控交叉注意力进行融合。几何分支引入了两个前瞻性物理信号——空间云异质性和逆变器功率下降活动，每个信号都根据经验加权至其最具预测性的时间范围。解码器将预测锚定在智能持续性基线上，学习一个随预测时间范围条件化的修正量，所得的分位数预测通过核加权自适应保形校准步骤进行在线校准。所提出的模型优于全部14个基线模型，ac（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了IMPACT框架，一种基于逆变器信息的物理驱动多模态深度学习方法，通过四分支架构（图注意力编码、太阳几何、气象状态）与门控交叉注意力融合，并结合自适应保形校准，实现10-110分钟提前期的概率性光伏功率预测，性能超越全部14个基线模型。
en_tdlr: IMPACT is a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework with a four-branch architecture (graph attention encoding, solar geometry, meteorological state) fused via gated cross-attention and adaptive conformal calibration, achieving probabilistic PV power forecasting over 10-110 minute horizons that outperforms all 14 baselines.
